M4 Markdown safe-quoting preamble.description: Recommended header for a .md.m4 file: switches m4's quote characters away from the default backtick/apostrophe pair (which collides with Markdown's `inline code` and ```fenced``` blocks) to [[double brackets]], and its comment delimiters to <!-- HTML comments --> (also hidden by Markdown's own renderer, and doesn't collide with # headings).
